map.HHI 多少算高度集中？: What HHI counts as highly concentrated?
map.常用口径：HHI 大于 2500 为高度集中，1500~2500 为中度集中，低: Common standard: HHI above 2500 is highly concentrated, 1500–2500 moderately concentrated, below 1500 competitively fragmented; thresholds vary slightly by regulatory standard.
map.CR3 和 HHI 有什么差别？: What is the difference between CR3 and HHI?
map.CR3 只看头部三家合计份额，容易忽略头部之间的差距；HHI 用份额平方求和，对: CR3 only looks at the combined share of the top three, easily overlooking gaps among the leaders; HHI sums squared shares, more sensitive to the relative scale of leading firms.
map.营收单位不统一怎么办？: What if revenue units are inconsistent?
map.本工具只做相对份额计算，单位不影响结果，但同一份输入内必须统一单位（如全部为亿元: This tool only does relative share calculation; units do not affect the result, but the same input must use unified units (e.g. all in 100 million CNY or all in 10,000 CNY).
